name: ReelsWp – Shoppable Videos & Vertical Reels Carousels
author: Debuggers Studio

sections.description:
Create Insta style reels and stories with ReelsWP and add them anywhere on your WordPress site. Add fast, mobile friendly video grid and carousel layouts to your homepage, blog or news articles, and product pages. With ReelsWP, you can tag products or add custom call-to-action links to boost sales.Turn Reels, TikToks, and UGC into high-impact shoppable videos that drive conversions. Highlight creator content with stronger social proof, and track clicks, views from every video.

Plugin Demo | Documentation | Get Pro for Advanced Features

Boost engagement and conversions on your Woocommerce store with shoppable videos. Use the ReelsWP video player widget to create vertical reels, stories, and short form UGC video carousels that build powerful social proof and 10X your sales.

Everything You Need to Build UGC Carousels on WordPress

  • Grid layout to display videos in a clean, responsive grid
  • Carousel layout to embed shoppable Instagram-like Reels & Stories
  • Marquee Reels layout (Pro) for infinite, auto-scrolling video playlists
  • Stacked Reels layout (Pro) for interactive and shoppable video experience
  • Full style customization including shape, colors, typography, size, and spacing
  • Swipe-based preview video player with horizontal and vertical (Pro) support
  • Video play control options including play on click, auto play (Pro), and play on hover (Pro)
  • Drag and drop (Pro) reordering to easily rearrange Reels and keep content fresh
  • Custom CTA links inside videos like Buy Now, Learn More, and Add to Cart
  • Product tagging inside videos for instant shoppable experience
  • Support for UGC videos with tagged products to boost conversions
  • Flexible video hosting support including Self Hosted videos and Vimeo (Pro)
  • Video view counter to show social proof on Reels and Stories
  • Elementor page builder support with dedicated ReelsWP widget
  • Gutenberg block editor support with built-in ReelsWP block
  • WooCommerce compatibility for seamless eCommerce integration

How to Create Reels with ReelsWP

  1. Upload your video Reels to your WordPress website using ReelsWP.
  2. Create a Reel widget and select the videos you want to display as a grid or carousel.
  3. Click Save and ReelsWP will automatically generate a shortcode.
  4. Paste the shortcode anywhere on your website to show shoppable videos.
  5. If you are using Gutenberg or Elementor, simply use the dedicated ReelsWP block or widget and select the playlist you want to display.

Performance Recommendations & Compatibility

For the best performance, we recommend compressing your videos before uploading and using modern video formats like WebM. The plugin is optimized for speed with lazy loading and smart caching, fully compatible with popular caching and CDN solutions, and built with a mobile-first, responsive design to ensure smooth performance across all devices.

If you are facing any issues or have suggestions or feedback, please share them on our support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Go to plugins in your dashboard and select “Add New”
  2. Search for “ReelsWP”, Install & Activate it
sections.faq:
Why Use the ReelsWP Plugin?

ReelsWP plugin lets you create interactive stories for your WordPress site using videos, images, text, buttons, and product links. Showcase user-generated content and let customers shop directly from your stories for an engaging experience.

Can I use the ReelsWP plugin with my existing WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most WordPress themes and integrates seamlessly into your website.

Can I use the ReelsWP plugin for eCommerce purposes?

Absolutely! The plugin is perfect for eCommerce. You can upload user-generated content (UGC) like videos and images and add product links to your stories. Visitors can directly purchase products from the story.

How can I display the stories on my website?

You can display your stories anywhere on your website using a simple shortcode from the ReelsWP plugin. Just copy and paste the shortcode into any page, post, or widget, and your story will appear.

Does the plugin support mobile-friendly stories?

Yes, the stories are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices to ensure the best viewing experience.

Can I track clicks on product links added to stories?

Yes, the ReelsWP plugin includes tracking functionality to help you monitor clicks on product links and measure user engagement.

How do I add reels or story features to my website?

To add reels or story videos to your website, you can use the WordPress plugin ReelsWP. This plugin allows you to directly upload and manage videos on your website effortlessly.
